theater: 努比亞與西奈半島瓦迪馬哈拉

battle.name: 斯尼夫魯的行動
battle.theater: 努比亞與西奈半島瓦迪馬哈拉
battle.brief: 第三王朝法老斯尼夫魯在位第十三年，率王身近衛與各州徵召兵沿尼羅河北上，討伐第一瀑布以南的努比亞部族，同時在東沙漠與西奈半島瓦迪馬哈拉開採銅礦、追擊西部沙漠的提耶呼奴游群。瓦迪馬哈拉的第十三年銘刻與薩卡拉王太子陵的編年殘片，是埃及最早有確切年號可考的遠征記錄；卡面這柄埃及長矛，正是這批隊伍手中的標準步兵兵器。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 斯尼夫魯的行動，是古埃及第三王朝建國初期以王權為核心的一場邊境遠征，交戰方並非兩個國家，而是「王權國家」與「沙漠—邊地部族」之間的反覆衝突。埃及一方以孟斐斯為中央，斯尼夫魯自居「上下埃及之王」，透過王宮近衛、各州州長按名冊提供的徵召兵，以及駐紮東沙漠的邊防武裝「麥德雅」三層力量出兵。麥德雅原是護獵、護路、押送礦工的半軍事隊伍，在斯尼夫魯時代已常駐沙漠，專責巡邏商路、追擊游群，是埃及最早的常備邊軍；徵召步兵則多為上、下埃及各州的農民，按季役與遠征需要臨時召集，並無常備員額。工役與後勤同樣編入遠征隊：石匠、銅匠、木匠、船工、醫者與書吏隨軍，統由「礦山監督」「獵首領」一類專職官員率領，負責開採、築路、築壘與記帳。對手一方沒有中央政權，是第一瀑布以南的努比亞部族聯盟（伊爾提特、塞特朱等）與西部沙漠的提耶呼奴游群：前者控制河運與瀑布區的黃金、象牙和魚產，後者控制綠洲、水井與橫穿沙漠的商道；兩者皆由部族首領帶領族眾作戰，靠游走、襲擊與撤退應對埃及的遠征大軍。整體而言，這是一場以「國家—部族」為結構、以護礦與護路為直接目標的邊境戰爭。
countriesEn: The campaigns of Sneferu were not a war between two states but a series of frontier clashes between a centralised river-valley monarchy and the desert and border tribes that ringed it. On the Egyptian side stood Old Kingdom Egypt in its Third Dynasty, centred on Memphis, with Sneferu ruling as 'King of Upper and Lower Egypt'. He drew on three layers of force: the royal bodyguard; the levies supplied by the nomarchs of Upper and Lower Egypt on their roll lists; and the 'medjay', the desert border troops who by Sneferu's reign had already become a standing military corps. The medjay had begun as hunters, caravan guards and mine-escorts, and were now charged with patrolling the trade routes, pursuing raiding bands and policing the mining camps. The levied infantry were mostly farmers from the nomes of Upper and Lower Egypt, called up by season and by the needs of an expedition, with no permanent establishment. Labour and logistics were part of the expedition itself: stonemasons, coppersmiths, carpenters, boatmen, physicians and scribes marched with the column, under officials bearing titles such as 'overseer of the mines' and 'chief of the hunters', responsible for quarrying, road building, fortification and accounting. The enemy had no central state. It was a Nubian coalition south of the First Cataract — the Irtjet, the Setju and their kin — together with the Tjehenu, the Libyan nomads of the Western Desert. The first controlled river traffic and the gold, ivory and fish of the cataract zone; the second held the oases, the wells and the caravan tracks that crossed the sand. Both fought under tribal leaders with loose bands of followers, answering the royal columns with skirmishing, sudden attack and retreat. The enterprise was therefore a frontier war structured as state against tribe, with the escorting of mines and the protection of caravan roads as its immediate aim.
people: 斯尼夫魯是這場行動的核心人物。他的名字是古埃及早期諸王中第一位完整保存下來的名字：荷魯斯名、王位名與本名俱全，「斯尼夫魯」意為「使之美麗」；他也是第一位在官方文書上完整使用「上下埃及之王」頭銜的法老，在位約二十四年（依曼涅托所記），沙夫年表把他的在位年代定在約公元前二六一三年至二五八九年。第十三年，他親自率隊遠征：西奈半島瓦迪馬哈拉的岩石上，至今仍留有他的王名、年號與「擊敵」場面；達赫舒爾紅金字塔的祭廟浮雕中，王以單人制伏俘虜的構圖，說明宮廷把這次遠征寫成國王親臨戰陣的功業。薩卡拉一座第三王朝王太子的馬斯塔巴陵，牆上「王宮正面」浮雕之下排列著格狀編年欄格，第十三年那一欄記錄的正是這次遠征，是今日了解此役最重要的直接材料。隨行官員的名字同樣留了下來：瓦迪馬哈拉的官署坑道與岩壁上見到署有官銜的高級官員刻名，其中「沙漠監督」與「獵首領」級的職銜，說明遠征的指揮鏈條一直延伸到邊地。家族方面，他的母后赫特斐麗斯一世與妻庫伊特二世在薩卡拉都有陵墓，後繼者胡夫則延續了他開啟的遠征與築城體制。對面的部族首領在埃及史料中不留姓名，只以「首領」「大人」一類尊號出現；唯一被記下姓名的，是宮廷中負責編寫這份年記的書吏。
peopleEn: Sneferu is the central figure of these campaigns. His is the first name of an early Egyptian ruler to survive complete: Horus name, prenomen and nomen all preserved, and 'Sneferu' means 'he who has made beautiful'. He was also the first pharaoh to use the full title 'King of Upper and Lower Egypt' in official documents. He reigned about twenty-four years according to Manetho, while the Shaw chronology dates his reign to roughly 2613 to 2589 BC. In year 13 he led an expedition in person: on the rock at Wadi Maghara in the Sinai his royal name, his regnal year and a scene of the king smiting an enemy are still cut into the stone, and in the mortuary temple reliefs of the Red Pyramid at Dahshur the king appears in the single-handed composition of a captive being subdued, which tells us the court wrote this campaign up as the king's own presence on the battlefield. In Saqqara, the mastaba of a Third Dynasty crown prince carries, beneath a 'palace façade' relief, a grid of annal entries; the entry for year 13 records precisely this expedition and is the single most important piece of direct evidence for it. The names of the accompanying officials survive as well: on the officials' galleries and rock walls of Wadi Maghara are cuts naming high officers, including titles such as 'overseer of the desert' and 'chief of the hunters', which show that the chain of command reached right out to the frontier. On the family side, his mother Hetepheres I and his wife Khuit II both have tombs at Saqqara, and his successor Khufu carried on the expedition and fortification system that Sneferu had opened. The tribal leaders opposite left no names in the Egyptian record and appear only under honorifics such as 'chief' or 'ruler'; the only person named is the court scribe who compiled the year-by-year record.
kits: 卡面這柄埃及長矛，就是遠征隊伍的標準步兵裝備：銅或青銅矛頭裝在硬木杆上，矛頭呈菱形或套筒形，刃長約四十至六十公分，全槍約兩公尺。第三王朝初年的埃及正處於銅器向青銅過渡的階段，這種長矛既能刺穿獵物與守城時的登梯者，也能在狹窄的礦坑道與城門前成列使用；史載埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地，正是指這類集團長矛的用法。與長矛並列的還有木製弓與箭（箭鏃用燧石或銅）、投石索、窄刃銅斧、石斧、匕首、削尖的短矛，以及木條與皮革製成的橢圓形小盾；護身只靠皮甲與皮革護肩，沒有金屬鎧甲。行軍裝備包括裝水與穀物的陶罐皮袋、油燈與粗麻布帳。運輸主力是尼羅河上的木船（以槳與帆推進），岸上靠牛拉的木橇、驢隊與步行搬運把銅礦、玄武岩與糧食運回河谷；開礦工程使用坑道支撐、木梁與石砌護牆，並在沙漠營地築環形防線與石砌崗哨。至遲在第三王朝初，埃及已開始使用牛拉的輕型車，多用於偵察、傳令與快速追擊，而不是主戰的衝鋒工具。
kitsEn: The Egyptian spear on the card is the standard infantry arm of the expedition columns: a copper or bronze head socketed onto a hardwood shaft, the blade lozenge-shaped or socketed, some forty to sixty centimetres long, giving a weapon about two metres overall. Egypt in the early Third Dynasty stood at the transition from copper to bronze, and a spear of this kind could stab a quarry beast or a man on a scaling ladder, and could be used in file inside a narrow mine gallery or at a city gate. The record that the Egyptians used it to defend ramparts and later to recover lost ground refers precisely to this kind of massed spear. Alongside the spear the army carried wooden bows and arrows with flint or copper heads, slings, narrow-bladed copper axes, stone axes, daggers, sharpened short spears, and small oval shields of wood strips covered in leather; personal protection amounted to hide cuirasses and leather shoulder guards, with no metal armour at all. Marching kit consisted of leather and pottery jars for water and grain, clay lamps and coarse linen tents. The main haulage was by wooden boats on the Nile, propelled by oar and sail, while on land ox-drawn sledges, donkey teams and men on foot carried copper ore, basalt and grain back to the valley. Mining works used timbered galleries, wooden beams and stone revetments, and desert camps were ringed by a defensive ditch with stone-built sentry posts. By the early Third Dynasty, at the latest, Egyptians were already using ox-drawn light vehicles, chiefly for scouting, despatch and rapid pursuit rather than as shock assault weapons.
tactics: 斯尼夫魯的行動採用「水陸並進、以護為主」的戰術。船隊沿尼羅河北上，運載步兵與全部給養，把大批徵召兵直接送到第一瀑布與東沙漠的集結點；隊伍一旦離船，便由熟悉沙漠的嚮導與麥德雅引路，在缺水高溫的地區以狹長的縱隊行軍以節省耗水，行軍距離按水囊與日行程計算。進入戰鬥時，步兵把長矛排成數列——早王朝尚未發展出成熟的橫陣與盾牆，陣形更接近密集的矛列，弓手置於兩翼或前列投射箭矢，斧兵與持矛者在後掩護；射程以弓為主，長矛用於把敵人逼入窄地與守衛營門。沙漠遭遇戰多以偷襲、劫營與斷糧為主：游群善於在沙丘後突然出現，殺傷落單者與汲水者後迅速退走，因此遠征軍通常在營地外挖壕、堆石、燃起火堆與配置哨兵，並把飲水與糧食集中在營心。對敵方營寨與邊地據點的攻擊，通常在夜裡或清晨發動，由步兵與麥德雅輕裝弓手同時下手，目的是摧毀帳幕、奪取牲畜與礦石，而非佔領土地。埃及象形藝術裡「王單獨擊敗俘虜」的固定構圖是王權儀式，不是戰術記錄；真正可用的戰術信息，仍要從銘刻的行程、官署坑道的位置與後勤安排去推想。
tacticsEn: The campaigns of Sneferu used a doctrine of movement by water and land combined, in which protection was the primary task. Flotillas went north up the Nile carrying infantry and the entire supply train, delivering large bodies of levies directly to the assembly points at the First Cataract and in the Eastern Desert. Once ashore, the columns were led by desert guides and by the medjay, marching in narrow files through country that was hot and short of water, so as to cut consumption, with the day's distance calculated from the water jars and the pace of the march. In action the infantry formed the spear in close files: the Early Dynastic army had not yet developed a mature battle line or shield wall, and the formation was closer to a dense mass of spears, with archers on the flanks or in front loosing arrows, and axe-men and spearmen covered behind them. The bow provided the effective range, while the spear was used to press the enemy into narrow ground and to guard the camp gate. Desert encounters were fought as raids, camp-breaking and cutting of supplies. The nomads knew how to appear suddenly from behind a dune, cut down stragglers and men drawing water, and vanish again, so the columns normally dug a ditch, piled stones, lit fires and posted sentries outside the camp, keeping water and grain at the centre. Attacks on enemy encampments and frontier posts were usually launched at night or at first light, with infantry and lightly equipped medjay archers striking together, the object being to destroy tents and seize cattle and ore rather than to occupy territory. The fixed Egyptian composition of the king single-handedly subduing a captive is a statement of royal ritual, not a tactical record; the usable tactical information has to be reconstructed from the itineraries in the inscriptions, the positions of the officials' galleries and the logistics of supply.
data: 關於這場行動，可靠的數字不多，但有幾項特別有價值。第一，第十三年是古埃及史上第一次有確切年號可考的王室遠征，在此之前阿爾王朝的對外用兵只有「某某年」的模糊記載。第二，薩卡拉王太子陵的編年殘片常被引用「七千人」與「二十萬頭牲畜」一類的概數來描述遠征規模；殘片漫漶、字跡殘缺，多數研究者認為這類數字帶有宮廷夸飾的慣例，只能當作量級參考，不能視為精確統計。第三，遠征隊伍由各州按名冊徵召，加上工匠、礦工與船工，整體規模以數千人計；西奈的開礦隊伍往往更大，因為它要同時搬運工具、糧食與水。第四，瓦迪馬哈拉一地在整個古埃及時期留下約數千方銘刻與數十處官署坑道，說明這類礦區的官方經營已相當成熟。第五，距離與季節：孟斐斯到第一瀑布的尼羅河航程約一千一百公里以上，到瓦迪馬哈拉的陸路約三百五十公里；遠征多在夏季涸水期與冬季低水期進行，因為此時陸路與淺灘可以通行，尼羅河的補給航線也能讓船隊直抵基地。第六，作為同時代工程量的旁證，達赫舒爾紅金字塔底邊約二百二十公尺、高約一百零五公尺，東沙漠維丹埃爾法拉斯的玄武岩採石場規模亦可觀，反映出國家能夠一次調動的勞動力與運輸能力，正是這些遠征得以成行的基礎。
dataEn: Few reliable figures survive for this campaign, but several are especially valuable. First, year 13 is the earliest royal expedition in Egyptian history that can be tied to an exact regnal year; the foreign campaigns of the Archaic period carry only vague 'in such-and-such year' entries. Second, the fragmentary annals in the mastaba of the crown prince at Saqqara are commonly cited for an expedition strength of around 'seven thousand men' and 'two hundred thousand head of cattle'; the slab is badly broken and the text incomplete, and most researchers treat such numbers as the court convention of magnification, useful only as an order of magnitude and certainly not as precise statistics. Third, the expedition was levied by name-list from the nomes and then augmented by craftsmen, miners and boatmen, so the overall force ran to several thousand men; the Sinai mining parties were often larger still, because they had to carry tools, grain and water at the same time. Fourth, Wadi Maghara alone carries on the order of several thousand inscriptions and several dozen officials' galleries across the whole of Egyptian history, which shows how thoroughly the official organisation of such a mining district had matured. Fifth, distance and season: the Nile run from Memphis to the First Cataract was upwards of about 1,100 kilometres, and the overland stretch to Wadi Maghara roughly 350 kilometres; expeditions moved mainly in the low-water months of summer and winter, when the desert tracks and shallows were passable and the Nile supply line could carry the boats right to the base. Sixth, as a parallel measure of contemporary engineering, the Red Pyramid at Dahshur has a base of about 220 metres and a height of about 105 metres, and the basalt quarry at Widan el-Faras in the Eastern Desert is comparably large; together they show the labour and transport that a state could mobilise at one time, which was precisely what made these expeditions possible.
cause: 斯尼夫魯之所以要打出這一連串邊境戰役，背景是第三王朝剛剛完成國家重組。早王朝末年把上、下埃及合為一體的君主所留下的中央集權框架，到斯尼夫魯手上第一次有了可用的行政與運輸機制，而這套機制立刻被兩種壓力拉扯。其一是資源：金字塔工程與王室祭祀對銅料、木材、黃金、象牙、緣石與綠松石的需求急遽上升，銅器用於工具與兵器，木材來自黎巴嫩方向的海上貿易，黃金與象牙則在南方；控制礦源等於控制財政，這就是王室要在東沙漠的維丹埃爾法拉斯玄武岩坑、在西奈的瓦迪馬哈拉綠松石礦與瓦迪賈拉布銅礦直接設署開採的理由。其二是安全：西部沙漠的提耶呼奴游群與努比亞的邊地部族會襲擊礦工隊、擄走牲畜、攔截商隊，切斷河谷與礦區之間的補給線；西奈方向還有不時南下的「亞細亞人」掠奪者，搶走綠松石與銅。國王的反應是把巡邏升級為遠征，用有年號、有編年的方式記錄每一次出兵，同時以「擊敵」的儀式性構圖把勝果歸於王權本身，藉此在新建的中央政府與地方州長之間建立正當性。於是，開礦、護商、懲罰游群與彰顯王威，在斯尼夫魯的行動裡合成了同一件事。
causeEn: Sneferu mounted these frontier campaigns against the background of a state that had just reorganised itself in the Third Dynasty. The framework of centralisation left by the ruler who had united Upper and Lower Egypt at the end of the Early Dynastic period only acquired a workable administrative and transport machinery in Sneferu's hands, and that machinery was immediately pulled in two directions. The first was resources: pyramid construction and the royal cults demanded rapidly rising quantities of copper, timber, gold, ivory, greenstone and turquoise. Copper served for tools and weapons, timber came by sea from the Levant, and gold and ivory lay to the south. Control of the mines was control of the treasury, and that is why the crown opened its own workings at the basalt quarry of Widan el-Faras in the Eastern Desert, at the turquoise mines of Wadi Maghara and the copper mines of Wadi el-Jarab in the Sinai. The second was security: the Tjehenu nomads of the Western Desert and the frontier tribes of Nubia raided mining parties, took cattle and intercepted caravans, cutting the supply line between the valley and the ore; in the Sinai, 'Asiatics' pushing south from time to time carried off turquoise and copper. The king's answer was to escalate patrol into expedition, to record every such expedition under a regnal year in an annal, and to credit the results to the royal person through the ritual composition of the king smiting the enemy, thereby establishing the legitimacy of a new central government in the eyes of the provincial nomarchs. Mining, protecting trade, punishing the nomads and displaying royal power were thus fused into a single enterprise in the campaigns of Sneferu.
impact: 斯尼夫魯的行動對古埃及的長期影響，遠大於它在戰場上的勝負。第一，它確立了「王室遠征」作為國家制度的形態：遠征隊不是純粹的軍隊，而是一支包括步兵、麥德雅邊軍、工匠、礦工、醫者、船工與書吏的移動行政體，同時進行戰鬥、建設、採礦與記帳；這套模式後來被古王國與中王國的遠征（例如前往瓦迪哈馬馬特取金、前往蓬地取香）一再沿用，影響了整個埃及國家的對外工程能力。第二，它把「麥德雅」從護獵與護路的民間隊伍，推向制度化的邊防武力，這支部隊日後演變為常駐南方邊境的守備力量，也是後來「謝赫」外族傭兵制度的源頭之一。第三，在疆域上，這次行動並沒有把努比亞併入埃及，卻把東沙漠與西奈的礦區置於王室的直接管理之下，瓦迪馬哈拉的官署坑道與銅綠松石配額即是明證；直到中王國在布亨等地築起要塞，埃及才第一次在南方建立常駐防禦。第四，它開啟了編年體的傳統：把遠征記成年號下的事蹟，寫在王太子陵的格狀欄格裡，成為後世法老自述功業的固定格式。第五，在戰術層面，這一時期的埃及仍以矛列與弓為主，早期車戰尚未成熟，因此這批遠征經驗主要貢獻在後勤與組織，而非機動戰術。
impactEn: The long-term effect of Sneferu's campaigns on Egypt was far greater than the outcome of any battle they fought. First, they fixed the form of the 'royal expedition' as an institution of the state. An expedition was not a pure army but a mobile administration combining infantry, medjay border troops, craftsmen, miners, physicians, boatmen and scribes, engaged in fighting, construction, quarrying and record-keeping at the same time; the model was taken up again and again by Old Kingdom and Middle Kingdom expeditions, such as the gold workings of Wadi Hammamat and the incense roads to Punt, and it shaped the state's entire capacity for works abroad. Second, the campaigns pushed the medjay from a private guild of hunters and caravan guards towards an institutionalised frontier military, a body that later became the garrison of the southern border and one of the sources of the later 'sher' system of foreign mercenaries. Third, in territorial terms the campaign did not incorporate Nubia into Egypt, but it did place the mining districts of the Eastern Desert and the Sinai under direct royal administration, as the officials' galleries at Wadi Maghara and the copper and turquoise quotas show; only with the Middle Kingdom fortresses at Buhen and elsewhere did Egypt first establish a permanent southern defence. Fourth, the campaigns opened the annalistic tradition: recording an expedition under a regnal year, laid out in the grid of an annal in a crown prince's mastaba, became the fixed formula by which later pharaohs set out their own achievements. Fifth, at the tactical level Egypt of this period still fought with spear files and bows, with mature chariot warfare still in the future, so the real contribution of these expeditions lay in logistics and organisation rather than in manoeuvre.
result: 斯尼夫魯的行動最終以「贏得邊界、沒有收復土地」收場。第十三年那次遠征，銘刻與薩卡拉編年都記下了埃及對努比亞部族的勝利、俘獲與貢賦，瓦迪馬哈拉的銘刻也在「擊敵」構圖下把成果歸給國王；但第一瀑布以南沒有被劃入埃及的州縣，埃及在南方維持的是影響力、貢賦往來與季節性的軍事巡行，而不是持續的佔領。銅礦開採權落入王室之後，西奈形成了「王室礦區」的體制：由中央派員設署、開採、把銅與綠松石運回河谷，並長期由軍隊護送；這套制度後來成為整個古王國經濟的底座。西部沙漠的提耶呼奴游群被壓制了一段時間，卻始終沒有被清剿，此後西線的緊張成為中王國強化「西部沙漠管理」的遠因。斯尼夫魯本人以紅金字塔作陵，把這批遠征的成果與其王權形象綁在一起；而薩卡拉王太子陵裡那一欄編年，則成為後世數千年不斷被摹寫與引用的樣板：國王以年號記錄遠征，以儀式性圖像確定功業，從此王室的每一次出征都有了可以追溯的編年格式。
resultEn: In the end the campaigns of Sneferu ended with the border won but no territory recovered. The expedition of year 13 is recorded in the inscriptions and in the Saqqara annals as a victory over the Nubian tribes, with captives and tribute taken, and the Wadi Maghara inscriptions assign the result to the king within the smiting composition; but no nome was created south of the First Cataract. What Egypt maintained in the south was influence, the flow of tribute and seasonal military rounds, not continuous occupation. Once the right to work the copper had passed to the crown, the Sinai became a 'royal mining district': officials were posted out from the centre, the ore was opened up, copper and turquoise were carried back to the valley, and the workings were escorted by troops the whole time. That system became the bedrock of the whole Old Kingdom economy. The Tjehenu nomads of the Western Desert were suppressed for a time but never hunted down, and the resulting tension on the western flank was one of the distant reasons for the Middle Kingdom's tighter 'Western Desert administration'. Sneferu himself was buried in the Red Pyramid, binding the results of these expeditions to his royal image, and the single annal column in the mastaba of the crown prince at Saqqara became a model copied and quoted for thousands of years afterwards: the king records his expeditions by regnal year and fixes his achievement in ritual image, and from that point every sortie of the crown had a traceable annalistic form.
